name: start_v3
description: Albayan platform — vanilla JS web app + FastAPI backend + Capacitor iOS/Android shells. See PLATFORM_FOUNDATION.md for platform rules.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.sync:mobile: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync && node scripts/fix-capacitor-spm-paths.js
scripts.test: npm run test:architecture && npm run test:mobile-config && npm run test:js && npm run test:mobile-ui && npm run test:money && npm run test:backend
scripts.release:prepare: npm run build && npm test && npm run sync:mobile && npm run verify:mobile
scripts.release:image: npm run build && npm test && docker build -t bashird/albayan:latest -f server/Dockerfile .
scripts.release:image:push: npm run release:image && docker push bashird/albayan:latest
